patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered within a defined maximum width, creating a spacious and premium feel, often featuring large imagery or video backgrounds.
A strong typographic contrast between elegant, large display serif fonts for primary headings and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and subheadings, establishing a sophisticated hierarchy.

Predominantly dark mode aesthetic (deep black/dark grey backgrounds with white text) for primary content, accented with subtle gold/tan hues and electric blue for interactive elements, shifting to a light mode for legal and footer sections.

The hero section features a full-bleed background video that either plays or subtly parallaxes, while overlaid text content remains fixed relative to the viewport. The main navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid background upon scroll, and subsequent content sections reveal with a fade-in or slide-up effect.
A 'stories' section employs a horizontal scrolling carousel for content cards, indicated by a numerical counter and navigation arrows, allowing for exploration of multiple related items.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed background video that either plays continuously or has a subtle parallax effect, with text content overlaid and fixed relative to the viewport to maintain readability. The primary navigation bar dynamically transitions from a transparent, minimal state over the hero to a sticky, solid background bar with a logo and dark text once the user scrolls past the initial hero view. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-in or subtle slide-up animation as they enter the viewport. A dedicated 'stories' section employs a horizontal scroll mechanism for a series of content cards, providing an interactive browsing experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant display serif headings (~4-5x body text) for impact, paired with clear, legible sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature very slight corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy for the hero and main content sections, creating a sense of luxury and space, becoming more balanced in feature grids and dense for legal disclaimers.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, cinematic video hero combined with a sophisticated dark mode aesthetic and elegant serif typography creates an immediate impression of luxury and high-end design. The transforming sticky navigation further enhances the premium user experience, making the site feel exceptionally polished and modern.
